description: List prescriptions at the Harris Teeter pharmacy — drug, Rx number, status (refillable, too soon, no refills), refills remaining, refill due date, last fill, price and prescriber. Needs an active pharmacy session (ht_rx_session).

patientNumber.description: Only this family member (from a previous result); default: every patient on the account.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands; "raw" returns the upstream payload unprojected. compact returns a projection of the documented fields; "full" returns the API payload minified; "raw" pretty-prints it.

name: ht_rx_list_prescriptions
